note: For each clean sample, passages that hold an SOP rule and the field each belongs in. `pnpm measure:extraction` checks that a verified claim quoting each passage sits in that field. vendor-payment-policy.md.quoteContains: controls how payments to external vendors are authorized
Every vendor payment above $10,000 requires the written approval
Finance stores the invoice, the purchase order and both approvals for seven years

vendor-payment-memo.md.quoteContains: vendor payments up to $25,000 need the approval of the Finance Director only
Payments above $25,000 still require both the budget owner and the CFO

incident-escalation-guide.md.quoteContains: describes how the on-call engineer handles a production incident
Start this procedure when a monitoring alert
Any database restore must be approved by the Engineering Manager
An incident is closed when the service has been healthy for 60 minutes

refund-policy.pdf.quoteContains: defines how customer refund requests are reviewed
applies to all refund requests for online orders
Support agents may approve refunds of up to $200
QA team audits a random 5% sample

expense-handbook.docx.quoteContains: A Director must approve reports above $500
